# China Used Auto Hub — Companies

> Company directory for the China used-car export ecosystem — profiles of exporters, agents, and related companies, with category browsing. Sub-site of China Used Auto Hub.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://company.chinausedautohub.com/): Entry point to the company directory.
- [Companies](https://company.chinausedautohub.com/companies/): Individual company profiles (via /companies/[company]/).
- [Categories](https://company.chinausedautohub.com/): Browse companies by category (via /[category]/).

## Legal & Policy

- [Terms](https://company.chinausedautohub.com/terms/): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](https://company.chinausedautohub.com/privacy/): Privacy policy.
- [Disclaimer](https://company.chinausedautohub.com/disclaimer/): Disclaimer.
- [Cookies](https://company.chinausedautohub.com/cookies/): Cookie policy.

## Parent site

- [China Used Auto Hub](https://chinausedautohub.com/): Main sourcing and inventory platform.

## Notes

- Unverified company records are excluded from indexing; verification status is shown per profile.
